## What changed and why?

Affected site page URL or repository file:

## Sources checked

For factual or time-sensitive changes, link direct sources and give the date checked. Explain any disagreement or uncertainty. Use "not applicable" for a change that makes no factual claim.

## Validation

Check only what you actually verified. Explain unchecked items below.

- [ ] `node scripts/check-content.mjs`
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `npx quartz build`
- [ ] Mobile and desktop screenshots inspected, or no visual change

Checks not run / remaining caveats:

## Privacy, design and rights

- [ ] No private data, secrets, stolen footage or material I cannot share
- [ ] Existing design, homepage ASCII and body wikilinks preserved

## Screenshots

For visual changes, add mobile and desktop evidence. Otherwise write "not applicable".
